title: Feature unlock cards
summary: A feature's first appearance: staggered icon / title / 'Unlocked!' / card over the level, tap to dismiss.
description: UnlockDirector opens UnlockOverlay on the Play of a level whose Levels/unlocks.json feature is not yet in PlayerState.unlocksSeen; beats in ui.json `unlock.*` (UnlockBeats). The card texts come from the puzzle module's unlock data.
notes: FeatureUnlock is GameCore's now (Session/FeatureUnlock.swift; the bundle's list reader stays in ArrowEscape). Registered by UnlockCardsRegistration.swift.
